# lean-pkg lease release

release a lease (holder-only unless --force); exporting or adopting a repository is `repo export` / `repo adopt`.

Also spelled: `lean-pkg release` ([all aliases](aliases.md)).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg lease release [--agent AGENT] [--force] [--reason REASON] [common flags] NAME
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--agent AGENT` | the holder; with --force, the acting agent recorded as released_by |
| `--force` | release another agent's lease; requires --reason |
| `--reason REASON` | free-text reason stored with the event |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `lease release NAME` | release a lease; holder-only unless forced; `--force` needs `--reason`; `released_by` is the acting `--agent`, else `force` | `[--agent]` `[--force --reason TEXT]` |

Exporting or adopting a public repository was `repo export NAME DIR` / `--adopt-repo DIR` before 1.0; it is [`repo export`](repo-export.md) / [`repo adopt`](repo-adopt.md) now (the old spellings keep working).

## JSON output

Top-level keys of `--json`, as recorded in the golden contract (tests/golden/json-keys.json):

- `release` (exit 0): `event`, `name`, `ok`, `released_lease`

## Examples

Give the lease back when you are done.

```bash
lean-pkg lease release my-proof --agent alice
```

Sample output:

```text
my-proof: lease released (was alice@laptop)
```
